lines.en: Tom, do you know the man who repaired my roof? He lives on our street.
lines.pt: Tom, você conhece o homem que consertou meu telhado? Ele mora na nossa rua.

lines.en: No, I don’t. Is he the roofer who works for the big company downtown?

lines.en: No, he is a carpenter who works alone. He is the person who painted my fence too.

lines.en: I need someone who can build a small deck in my yard.
lines.pt: Preciso de alguém que possa construir um deque pequeno no meu quintal.

lines.en: Then call him. He is a man who never leaves a job unfinished.
lines.pt: Então ligue para ele. Ele é um homem que nunca deixa um trabalho inacabado.

lines.en: Good. Is that the truck that is parked in front of your house?

lines.en: Yes, it is. The tools that he uses are old, but he works very well.
lines.pt: Sim, é. As ferramentas que ele usa são velhas, mas ele trabalha muito bem.

lines.en: I also know a gardener who plants trees. She cleaned the yard my uncle bought.
lines.pt: Eu também conheço uma jardineira que planta árvores. Ela limpou o quintal que meu tio comprou.

lines.en: Is she the woman you hired last spring? She cut the grass that grows near the fence.

lines.en: Yes. The plumber who came last month was good too. I have his number.

lines.en: Perfect. Send me the numbers that you have, and I will call them tonight.

facts.big: a man who… · a truck that…
facts.label: Relativas com who/that
facts.sub: Pessoa: who + verbo. Coisa: that + verbo. Sem sujeito repetido. Objeto: pronome pode sumir: the tools he uses.

facts.label: Que (pessoa)
facts.sub: Use who para falar de pessoas: the man who repaired my roof, a carpenter who works alone. Who vem logo depois do substantivo e funciona como sujeito. O verbo vem depois de who, sem repetir he ou she.

facts.label: Que (coisa)
facts.sub: Use that para falar de coisas: the truck that is parked outside. Também aceita pessoas na fala comum. That vem logo depois do substantivo. Evite usar what no lugar de that.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We say “the man who he repaired the roof”.
items.why: We say: the man who repaired the roof.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Who is for people. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
That can be for things. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “the man who he repaired the roof”. → Falso (We say: the man who repaired the roof.)

pages.title: Finding good workers in Denver · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Sunday morning in Denver. Tom has a small yard behind his house. He wants a wooden deck for the summer. His neighbor Gabe is working on the fence. The mountains stand in the distance. Tom asks Gabe for the name of a good worker.

“Tom, do you know the man who repaired my roof? He lives on our street.” says Gabe. “No, I don’t. Is he the roofer who works for the big company downtown?” says Tom. “No, he is a carpenter who works alone. He is the person who painted my fence too.” says Gabe.
